name: Edition / Numbering
summary: Passive target-formatted edition statement with optional designation, impression or piece identifier, and edition total.

anatomy.name: root
anatomy.description: Passive native edition statement, omitted when every content value is blank.

anatomy.name: count
anatomy.description: Private structural group for the optional number and total relationship.

anatomy.name: number
anatomy.description: Opaque target-formatted impression or piece identifier.

anatomy.name: separator
anatomy.description: Meaningful slash rendered only between a present number and total.

anatomy.name: total
anatomy.description: Opaque target-formatted edition-size value; not inventory.

variants.name: limited
variants.description: Statement-surface emphasis without warning, verification, scarcity, or inventory semantics.

states.name: default
states.description: Passive edition statement with no interaction state.

behavior.name: passiveMetadata
behavior.description: Targets supply truthful values and localization; the component does not verify provenance, authenticity, scarcity, availability, produced quantity, or inventory.

behavior.name: contentOmission
behavior.description: Blank content parts omit; the root omits when every content value is blank, and the separator exists only when number and total are both present.

properties.name: variant
properties.description: Selects neutral or statement-surface emphasis without creating a feedback state.

properties.name: number
properties.description: Opaque target-formatted impression or piece identifier; the component does not parse or validate its domain meaning.

properties.name: total
properties.description: Opaque target-formatted edition-size value; the component does not equate it with inventory or produced quantity.

properties.name: label
properties.description: Complete target-authored edition or proof designation.

accessibility: Use the visible native statement as the accessible content; paragraph naming with aria-label or aria-labelledby is prohibited.
Expose the slash when it communicates the relationship between a present number and total.
Do not rely on limited-edition color alone or represent it as warning, verification, scarcity, authenticity, or inventory state.
Isolate opaque target strings for mixed-direction content and preserve complete localized wording.

web.notes: Implemented in components/css/ceramics.css with native target markup documented in the contract and MDX.
